主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, which is a report to the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing is for the month of March 2012 and includes information about the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E (the 'Notes') by Royal Bank of Canada. The Notes have an aggregate principal amount of $1,250,000,000 and a coupon rate of 1.15%, with a maturity date of March 13, 2015. The filing includes various exhibits, such as opinions from legal counsel regarding the validity of the Notes under New York and Canadian law, as well as consents from the same legal counsel. The filing was signed by James Salem, Senior Vice-President and Treasurer of Royal Bank of Canada, on March 14, 2012.
